regions.title: THE COLOUR-CHANGING CURATOR
regions.text: The fictional chameleon's vivid colours echo Quantum's pulsing animation. Its perch on the frame joins the living character to the digital-art reference; it does not portray a real participant.

regions.title: THE RAINBOW OCTAGON
regions.text: Concentric colour bands against black recall Quantum's animated octagonal form. This framed illustration is a static interpretation, not the original file or a claim that Quantum was a physical painting.

regions.title: THE NAMECOIN REGISTRY
regions.text: NAMECOIN, Art claim and Record make the registration idea visible. This paper book is invented. A blockchain record preserves a claim; it cannot by itself prevent copying or guarantee authenticity or copyright.

regions.title: PAINT ON THE PAGE
regions.text: Paint marks on the registry and the tubes beside it tie record-keeping to artistic work. They are playful studio details, not evidence about the tools, venue or process used in 2014.
